description: Check a live formula without saving it. Free and unmetered, so iterate on it freely. On success returns { ok: true, normalised, pairs, primitives, horizonSeconds, cost: { rowsPerEvaluation, rowsPer30Days } }. On a refusal returns { ok: false, error } where error carries a stable code, a message, the location (at, pointer under the source) and suggestions such as the correct pair spelling: apply them and check again. A formula is an arithmetic expression over live order book and trade data, evaluated server-side every interval (default 1 s). Pairs are written venue:SYMBOL exactly as blackforge_symbols spells them (binance:BTCUSDT, okx:BTC-USDT, coinbase:BTC-USD), and one formula may combine pairs on different venues. Durations are 1s to 60s, or 1m. Book state, read now: bid ask bidQty askQty mid spread spreadBps bidLevels askLevels quoteUsd last lastAge, each (pair). Book walk: bidDepth askDepth imbalance (pair, bps) with bps an integer 1 to 200 written as a number; buyCost sellCost (pair, usd) with usd 100 to 1000000, result in bps. Trades over a window: buyVol sellVol vol buyUsd sellUsd volUsd buyCount sellCount tradeCount netFlow buyShare vwap high low open close maxBuy maxSell (pair, duration); buyUsdAbove sellUsdAbove buyCountAbove sellCountAbove (pair, duration, usd) with usd one of 100, 1000, 10000, 100000. Book changes over a window: bidAdded askAdded bidRemoved askRemoved bidAddedNear askAddedNear bidRemovedNear askRemovedNear bookChanges (pair, duration). Scalar: abs sign sqrt ln log10 exp pow min max clamp round floor ceil if coalesce. Windows over any expression: avgOver minOver maxOver stdOver change pctChange (expr, duration). Operators + - * / ^, comparisons, and, or, not. A missing input gives null, never a made-up number. The sum of windows on any path (the horizon) is at most 60 s. Examples: mid(binance:BTCUSDT) - mid(okx:BTC-USDT); imbalance(binance:ETHUSDT, 50); buyVol(binance:SOLUSDT, 60s) / max(sellVol(binance:SOLUSDT, 60s), 1); avgOver(spreadBps(kraken:XBTUSD), 1m). Live formulas and notifications are part of the Ultra plan.

expr.description: The formula source, e.g. mid(binance:BTCUSDT) - mid(okx:BTC-USDT).
